title: Ask the person to come to a page
description: Show the person a desktop notification asking them to come to this page, also while the DSphere side panel is closed (for example when a dsagent.page.ask question waits for them, or the task needs them on the page). Clicking it brings the page forward and opens the side panel.
guidance: Do not use it for a sign-in or verification wall the person is waiting on (authentication.waitingOn person): DSphere notifies the person itself. On a verification challenge you hold (authentication.waitingOn agent) that you cannot pass, call it: the challenge is handed to the person (challengeHandedToPerson true; DSphere shows its sign-in sheet and its own notification) and waitingOn becomes person. The message is short plain text in the user's language, without links or credentials; at most one notice per page every 30 seconds. It does not wait for the person and is not consent to any action.

inputSchema.description: The page and the short message for the person.

pageContextId.description: The task page context returned by page.open; the notification brings this page forward when clicked.

message.description: What the person is asked to do on the page, in their language; plain text, no links.

pageContextId.description: The task page context returned by page.open; the notification brings this page forward when clicked.

shown.description: True when the notification was shown; false when one for this page was shown less than 30 seconds ago.

retryAfterMs.description: When not shown: how long until a notice for this page may be shown again.

challengeHandedToPerson.description: Present and true when a verification challenge you held on this page was handed to the person by this call: read the page again only once they passed it (authentication absent); do not act on the challenge any more.
